ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Ground`. `up` is already true, but `Ground`'s transition is delayed, and a delayed transition is never checked in the tick its state was entered (the state's *entry tick*).

`Ground` was entered in an earlier tick, so now its transition is checked. `up` is still true (an input keeps its value), so the chart moves to `First` and `floor` becomes 1. This is `First`'s entry tick, so `First`'s delayed transition waits.
`First`'s transition may fire now: `up` is true, so the chart climbs to `Second` and `floor` is 2. A chain of delayed transitions moves at most one step per tick.
`Second` has no outgoing transitions, so the chart stays there.
